what: American Financial Group writes specialty property and casualty insurance: cover for trucking fleets, agriculture, workers' compensation and other niches that standard insurers avoid.
customers: Businesses with specialised risks, reached through independent agents and brokers.
money: trucking, agriculture and ocean marine cover
workers' compensation, executive liability and excess lines
moat: Underwriting expertise in narrow niches, where pricing a risk correctly requires years of loss data that a generalist insurer does not have.
risks: Specialty insurance pricing moves in cycles and has been softening after several strong years
Reserve additions on old liability claims can hit earnings years after a policy was written
Only six analysts cover the stock and their average target is where it already trades
opportunities: 12.8 times earnings and 7.4 times free cash flow with $1.8B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $6.6B to $8.2B in four years with consistent underwriting profits
$1.7B of cash and a history of paying large special dividends when capital builds up
watch: The combined ratio by segment and whether premium rates are still rising.
